---
title: "Course Schedule"
---

The course meets **Thursdays, 4:35–7:35 pm** in **Lafayette Hall L202**. Week 1 (Sep 3) only is a virtual session (link will be emailed); every class after that is in person. There are 16 calendar weeks but only 13 teaching weeks (2 no-class weeks + 1 field trip week). Slides and readings will be linked as the semester progresses.

All five homework assignments (see [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd#grading-policy) for topics) live in your [Posit Cloud workspace](https://posit.cloud/spaces/738679/content/12820277) as `hw1.qmd`–`hw5.qmd`; due dates are noted inline below.

---

## Unit 1 — Foundations {.unit-header}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Core skills: R basics, tidyverse, dplyr, data import, EDA, ggplot2
*R for Data Science*: Intro, Whole Game, Data Transformation, Data Import, EDA, Layers, Communication
:::

| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sep 3 | What is data? What is data science? Intro to R — **virtual session, link will be emailed** | [Week 1](slides/week01.html) | R4DS Intro |
| 2 | Sep 10 | dplyr basics; into the tidyverse — *HW1 due* | [Week 2](#) | R4DS Ch. 3–4 |
| 3 | Sep 17 | Getting data: APIs, scraping, joins | [Week 3](#) | R4DS Ch. 7–8 |
| 4 | Sep 24 | Exploratory data analysis; intro to ggplot2 — *HW2 due* | [Week 4](#) | R4DS Ch. 10–11 |
| 5 | Oct 1 | Advanced ggplot2; principles of effective visualization | [Week 5](#) | R4DS Ch. 12–13 |

## Unit 3 — Spatial Analysis {.unit-header}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Supplemental to R4DS — see [*Spatial Data Science*](https://r-spatial.org/book/) and [*Analyzing US Census Data*](https://walker-data.com/census-r/index.html), both free online. Packages: `sf`, `tidycensus`, `tigris`, `ggspatial`
:::

| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | Oct 22 | Intro to GIS; Census geography; sf and tidycensus; basic choropleths — *HW3 due* | [Week 8](#) | *Analyzing US Census Data* — chapters TBD |
| 9 | Oct 29 | Advanced GIS; non-Census spatial data; publication-level cartography — *HW4 due* | [Week 9](#) | *Spatial Data Science* — chapters TBD |
